itens.trecho: O argumento afiado de Tina Fey é indiscutivelmente um dos pontos fortes de "Mean Girls", capturando com humor várias caraterísticas da adolescência e criando uma sátira inteligente sobre os jovens do início da década de 2000.

"Cady" (Lindsay Lohan) has spent much of her life being home schooled by her scientist parents in the African wilderness. Maybe that ought to have prepared her for her relocation to an American High School where the dog eat dog attitude is just as prevalent.
